case: Argon2id cost above the sensitive ceiling is rejected before open
notes: The KDF parameters are read before the AEAD authenticates the header, so the AAD cannot protect them, and Argon2id is a synchronous non-interruptible call: an unbounded opsLimit makes a damaged or hostile header hang the unlock instead of failing it. ADR 0081 Gate P1 vector. Synthetic header and ciphertext metadata only; no private keys, no unlock runtime, no AEAD open result and no commercial permission.
